data.tourName: The Thai Express: Bangkok & Pattaya Coastal Escape (Mumbai Gateway)
data.overview: A dynamic 6-day itinerary seamlessly blending the ancient temples and modern pulse of Bangkok with the vibrant beach life and entertainment of Pattaya. This trip utilizes efficient travel planning, departing from and returning to Mumbai, offering a perfect short break in Thailand's most popular destinations.
data.dayTitle1: Day 1: Arrival in Bangkok & River Cruise Experience
data.dayDesc1: Depart from Mumbai (BOM) via an early morning flight to Bangkok (BKK). Upon arrival at Suvarnabhumi Airport, meet your representative and transfer to your hotel. After check-in and leisure time, the evening is dedicated to experiencing the city from the water. Enjoy a spectacular Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise, passing illuminated landmarks like Wat Arun and the Grand Palace, complete with live music and a international buffet dinner.
data.dayDesc2: Start the day with a guided tour of Bangkok's historical heart. Visit the magnificent Grand Palace and the sacred Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha). Continue to Wat Pho to marvel at the enormous Reclining Buddha. In the afternoon, shift gears to modern Bangkok with time dedicated to high-end shopping at Siam Paragon or finding bargains at the bustling MBK Center. End the day relaxing at a rooftop bar overlooking the city skyline.
data.dayTitle3: Day 3: Transfer to Pattaya & Sanctuary of Truth
data.dayDesc3: After breakfast and check-out, take a comfortable road transfer (approx. 2-hour drive) to the coastal city of Pattaya. Check into your hotel and have lunch. In the afternoon, visit the awe-inspiring Sanctuary of Truth, a massive wooden temple constructed purely by hand, reflecting Thai, Khmer, Chinese, and Indian spiritual artistry. The evening is free to explore the vibrant nightlife and entertainment options around Walking Street.
data.dayTitle4: Day 4: Coral Island (Koh Larn) Beach Day
data.dayDesc4: Today is dedicated to relaxation and water sports. Take a speedboat excursion to Koh Larn (Coral Island). Enjoy the white sandy beaches, crystal clear waters, and participate in optional activities such as parasailing, jet skiing, or snorkeling. Return to Pattaya late in the afternoon. In the evening, consider an optional visit to the famous Alcazar or Tiffany Cabaret Show for a spectacular display of costumes and dance.
data.dayTitle5: Day 5: Pattaya Floating Market & Flight to Mumbai
data.dayDesc5: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Check out of the hotel around noon. Before heading to the airport, stop by the unique Pattaya Floating Market for last-minute souvenir shopping and local snacks. Transfer (approx. 1.5 - 2 hours) to Suvarnabhumi (BKK) or Don Mueang (DMK) Airport for your scheduled late evening flight back to Mumbai (BOM). Dinner will be served either before the flight or onboard, depending on the airline schedule.
data.dayDesc6: Arrive at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM) in Mumbai during the early hours of the morning, concluding the six-day journey across Thailand. Transfer from the airport to your onward destination, taking with you memories of Thailand’s temples, beaches, and bustling cityscapes.
